Q: Best SQL Function for Text Filtering A:

Like others say, you can use LIKE on your column, but CONTAINS_SUBSTR is a better choice because this function is optimized for performance when working with large datasets. Remember that this function is case sensitive.

Here is the official documentation: https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/string_functions#contains_substr

Q: React Native Video iOS crash: RCTVideoManager.swift fatal error unexpectedly found nil while unwrapping A:

The issue occurs because `RCTBridge.current()` returns nil in newer React Native versions, and it is being force-unwrapped which causes the crash.

Fix:

1. Go to:

node_modules/react-native-video/ios/Video/RCTVideoManager.swift

2. Replace:

return RCTVideo(eventDispatcher: (RCTBridge.current().eventDispatcher() as! RCTEventDispatcher))

With:

return RCTVideo(eventDispatcher: nil)

3. Clean build folder in Xcode and rebuild the app.

4. IMPORTANT: Do not modify node_modules directly. Use patch-package:

npx patch-package react-native-video

5. Add this in package.json:

"postinstall": "patch-package"

This ensures the fix persists after reinstalling dependencies.

Q: docker-compose up not running app correctly A:

You're pointing at the wrong folder. Your index.html is in /dist/my-app, like i saw from the photo you posted here: https://postimg.cc/MntD9mFM.

Modify your Dockerfile and docker-compose to point to the correct folder.

Build 1

Dockerfile

FROM nginx
MAINTAINER Phil
#optional
RUN rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*

VOLUME /Users/Phil/Documents/myapp/myapp-docker/frontend/dist/my-app:usr/share/nginx/html

EXPOSE 80

docker-compose:

version: '3'
services:
    web:
        build: ./frontend
        ports:
            - "80:80"
        links:
        - node
        volumes:
        - "/Users/Phil/Documents/myapp/myapp-docker/frontend/dist/my-app:/usr/share/nginx/html"
    node:
        build: ./backend
        ports:
        - "3000:3000"

Build 2 (better)

You can also ignore Dockerfile cause docker-compose point already to your volume so your new docker-compose will look like:

version: '3'
services:
    web:
        image: nginx
        ports:
            - "80:80"
        links:
        - node
        volumes:
        - "/Users/Phil/Documents/myapp/myapp-docker/frontend/dist/my-app:/usr/share/nginx/html"
    node:
        build: ./backend
        ports:
        - "3000:3000"

Q: Authenticate with Windows Credentials in Python A:

The following worked for me when connecting to sharepoint using requests_negotiate_sspi:

import requests
from requests_negotiate_sspi import HttpNegotiateAuth

proxies = {'https': "https://user:password@proxyIP:port"}
response = requests.get('www.google.com', proxies=proxies, auth = HttpNegotiateAuth())

Q: Missing expression after unary operator '-'. At line:1 char:2 A:

At the end I am able to crack the issue and it was very difficult to find. Our administartor copied/pasted the command line for NSC.ini file from a MS-Word document (How To doc.) shared by me to them. In the original MS-Word doc the hypen (at the end of the line after the word command in the beow given command line) has automatically changed to a little bigger hypen during documentation, which also gone to the NSC.ini file and hence the error was coming for this particular command execution. After changing the hypen manually in the NSC.ini, it worked fine without any issues
